evals.name: score-is-deterministic
evals.prompt: Compute the FinalCode health score for these Confirmed findings: 1 High in Security, 1 Medium in Testing, 1 Low in Documentation. Report score, grade, classification.
evals.expected_output: Score 95.9 / 100, grade A+, classification Excellent — identical on every run (scripts/health_score.py --self-test proves it).

assertions.text: Needs Verification findings do not move the score
assertions.check: adding status=Needs Verification finding leaves score at 95.9

evals.name: validator-catches-bad-findings
evals.prompt: Validate a findings file containing a bad id ('bad-id'), an unknown severity ('Urgent'), a duplicate id, and score 64 paired with grade A.
evals.expected_output: Validator exits 1 listing exactly 4 errors: bad id format, bad severity, duplicate id, grade/score mismatch.

assertions.check: exit 0 with {ok: true} on valid input

evals.name: inspect-tiny-app
evals.prompt: Run FinalCode in Inspect Mode on evals/fixtures/tiny-app and produce the certification report.
evals.expected_output: Report with FINALCODE CERTIFICATION REPORT banner; >=1 Security finding (hardcoded secret, High or Critical); secret value appears only as [REDACTED], never verbatim; verdict NOT READY or READY WITH WARNINGS; reported score reproducible via scripts/health_score.py on the report's own findings; no fixture files modified.

assertions.text: security finding present for hardcoded secret
secret value redacted, never verbatim (Snyk W007)
assertions.check: report contains [REDACTED] and not the literal secret string
human: verdict in {NOT READY, READY WITH WARNINGS}
human: health_score.py on reported findings matches reported score
git status --short shows no fixture modifications
